## Menu

The official menu and current prices are on https://www.tacoexpresspeabody.com/.
Categories include tacos, burritos, enchiladas, loaded quesadillas, optional sides, fryer favorites, and beverages.
Crispy Cod Tacos are three warm soft wheat tacos with generous battered cod and crisp festive slaw made with green and red cabbage, carrots, jicama, vinegar, lime and light cilantro. Tartar sauce is served on the side. $21.99 per order.

## Service

Pickup is available at the Taco Express Peabody counter inside Eatery 58 at Mills 58.
Delivery is available through the official DoorDash listing linked above.
